vectors.name: admin/interface
vectors.description: The canonical interface document of sparrow.hub.admin v1 (hub-admin section 5): types 64-79, enum sigils 64-70 (kind 0), service 0 Admin with methods 0-8. Method flags: 0x1 (idempotent) on get, validate, confirm, deleteSecret and listSecrets; 0x10 on watch, whose output is [3, Event]; no other flags. An optional field has flag 0x1 and its plain type. The interface document is named sparrow.hub.admin, version "1.0.0", carries no annotations, and its methods list no errors, since every error they use is a core code (hub-admin 5).

vectors.name: admin/facet
vectors.description: A hub's sparrow.hub.admin facet, version 1.0.0, under facet ID 20 (the hub's choice). It implements admin/interface and adds the hint annotation "sparrow.level": "manage" to every method (hub-admin section 1); annotations are not part of wire shapes, so it conforms.

vectors.name: admin/value/config
vectors.description: A Config (type 64) with five nodes, each with its Link (field 0, a union): acme.charts dialing in (variant 1, the secret it presents); acme.notes dialed (variant 0, a Dial) at an https URL with a 32-byte pin and the credential secret the hub presents; acme.sensor dialing in; hub-b, a peer hub dialing in; acme.old, disabled. defaults maps the Renderer interface hash to acme.charts, and extensions carries the reference server's ref.policy as an embedded CBOR document. Absent optional fields are null and trailing nulls are omitted.

vectors.description: Problems (type 72, alias of list<Problem>): each Problem.path lists the keys from the document root using the field names of hub-admin section 3, with a union's variant name as one more key ("link", then the Link variant "credential" or "dial", then "pin" inside Dial); byte-string map keys would be lowercase hex (hub-admin 5.1).
